name: Electronic Mechanic Semester 1 Prep - Chapter Test

questions.question: Which semiconductor material is most commonly used in electronic chips?
questions.hint: Silicon is the most popular semiconductor due to abundance and performance.

questions.question: What is the main function of a diode?
options: Allowing current in one direction only
questions.hint: A diode acts as a one-way valve for electric current.

questions.question: What is the colour code for a 1k Ohm resistor with 5% tolerance?
Which component stores electrical energy in an electric field?
questions.hint: A capacitor stores energy in its electric field.

questions.question: What does "IC" stand for in electronics?
Which instrument is used to view electrical signal waveforms in real time?
questions.hint: An oscilloscope (CRO/DSO) plots voltage signals over time.

questions.question: Which logic gate gives a high output (1) only when all inputs are low (0)?
questions.hint: A NOR gate yields 1 only when A and B are 0 (NOT OR).

questions.question: Common electronics solder is an alloy composed of which metals?
questions.hint: Standard solder is composed of Tin (Sn) and Lead (Pb) in ratios like 60/40.

questions.question: What is the frequency of pure Direct Current (DC)?
questions.hint: DC flows constantly in one direction and does not alternate, meaning its frequency is 0.

questions.question: Which component is primarily used to amplify weak electronic signals?
questions.hint: Transistors act as amplifiers and electronic switches.

questions.question: What does BJT stand for in transistor electronics?
questions.hint: BJT stands for Bipolar Junction Transistor.

questions.question: What is the approximate forward voltage drop of a standard Silicon diode?
questions.hint: Silicon PN junctions require about 0.7 V forward bias to conduct, while Germanium drops about 0.3 V.

questions.question: What is the unit of electrical inductance?
questions.hint: The Henry (H) is the SI unit of self and mutual inductance.

questions.question: Which instrument can measure voltage, current, and resistance?
questions.hint: A multimeter combines multiple measurement functions in one unit.

questions.question: What is the main application of a Zener diode?
questions.hint: Zener diodes are operated in reverse breakdown to maintain stable reference voltages.
